newsitem.title: USA: Stock mutual funds' new cash slowed in March - ICI.
newsitem.headline: Stock mutual funds' new cash slowed in March - ICI.

text.p: Net new cash flowing to stock mutual funds slowed in March to $9.5 billion from February's $18.45 billion inflow, the Investment Company Institute said Thursday.
The mutual fund industry trade group said the March estimated flow to stock funds was the lowest since July 1996, when the funds took in $5.75 billion.
The ICI said bond and income funds had an estimated outflow of $1 billion in March, compared with an inflow of $2.17 billion in February.
The group said its monthly estimates were derived from unpublished weekly estimates that are based on a survey of long-term funds that account for about 97 percent of long-term mutual fund assets.
